newsitem.title: USA: SunAmerica still seeks merger opportunities.
newsitem.headline: SunAmerica still seeks merger opportunities.

text.p: SunAmerica Inc, one of a handful of major life insurance industry consolidators, will continue to look for attractive merger opportunities, the company's chairman said in a statement.

"SunAmerica has a history of high-return, quality acquisitions, and we will continue to look for attractive opportunities as the insurance industry continues to consolidate," SunAmerica chairman Eli Broad said.
SunAmerica said it has augmented its growth with acquisitions, adding more than $9.8 billion of fixed annuity reserves over the past 15 months.
In March, the company completed its acquisition of the approximately $5 billion annuity business of John Alden Financial Corporation.
The company now holds more than $22 billion in fixed and variable annuity reserves, more than double the $9.3 billion held two years ago on March 31, 1995.

SunAmerica said its expertise and experience at assimilating acquired businesses and its substantial investment in technology will enable it to integrate the Alden acquisition quickly and at a very low cost.
